tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deeel green, the brand anchor. Primary buttons, active tab, featured card border, 'Best match' badge, active diet chip. White text on it 5.23:1; as text on bg 4.87:1, on surface 5.23:1.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Featured (Section A) card background and soft primary fills. text 13.8:1, primary 4.56:1 on it; do not put text-muted on it (4.22:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, accent-violet, allergen, score-* and unverified fills.

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Sunshine yellow, a hype accent: savings stickers ('Meal deal saves £1.70'), credits, marketing blocks. Dark text only (text on it 10.9:1); never white text.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Electric violet, a hype accent: Deeel score marketing, stickers, poster blocks. White text 5.85:1; as text on surface 5.85:1.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Cyan, a hype accent: marketing blocks and stickers. Dark text only (text on it 7.64:1); white on it fails (2.07:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-yellow and accent-cyan.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (Streamlit backgroundColor): the cream from the logo files. text 15.0:1, primary 4.97:1, text-muted 4.60:1, allergen-ink 6.15:1 on it.

tokens.name: logo-leaf
tokens.usage: The logo's leaf lime, picked by eye from the logo. Decoration and highlights only (active tab bar, hero art). Dark text on it only; never as text colour.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: The logo's own deep green. Wordmark and page headings in marketing and the app header. White text on it 10.8:1; as text on bg 10.3:1. Not a replacement for primary.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, filter sheet (Streamlit secondaryBackgroundColor).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and divider hairlines. Decorative only (1.29:1 on surface): never the sole edge of an input or chip.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of inactive chips, pills and custom inputs: 3.25:1 on surface, meets the 3:1 UI-component floor.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface, primary-tint, accent-yellow and accent-cyan; label ink on rank markers.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dates, struck-through separate prices. On surface 4.83:1; on bg exactly 4.50:1 (the floor). Not on tints.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fills behind dark text or as an icon/marker only. White text on it fails (3.30:1): use success-ink for text.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on surface (5.02:1) or success-tint (4.79:1); credits approved, 'Done ✓'.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success banners and the 'Approved' / credits pill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon or marker only. As text it fails (3.19:1 white on it): use warning-ink.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface (5.02:1) or warning-tint (4.84:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning boxes and the ageing freshness badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and 'Not accepted'. White on it 4.83:1; as text on surface 4.83:1. Semantic only, never decoration.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on surface (5.17:1) and info-tint (4.75:1).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info boxes and the unverified tag.

tokens.name: allergen
tokens.usage: Active allergy chip fill (white text 4.83:1). Serious mode only. For text use allergen-ink: as text on bg this is exactly at the 4.5:1 floor.

tokens.name: allergen-ink
tokens.usage: 'Allergies — avoid' heading, allergy warning text and allergen lines: on allergen-tint 5.91:1, surface 6.47:1, bg 6.03:1, primary-tint 5.65:1.

tokens.name: allergen-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the allergy warning box.

tokens.name: rank-1
tokens.usage: Map marker and rank badge #1. Label in rank-ink (4.79:1), always with the number.

tokens.name: rank-2
tokens.usage: Map marker and rank badge #2. Label in rank-ink (8.24:1); the code's white label failed (1.92:1).

tokens.name: rank-3
tokens.usage: Map marker and rank badge #3+. Label in rank-ink (5.64:1); white failed (2.80:1).

tokens.name: rank-out
tokens.usage: Out-of-range or filtered-out marker. Label in rank-ink (6.16:1).

tokens.name: rank-ink
tokens.usage: Number label on every rank-* marker and badge.

tokens.name: score-high
tokens.usage: Deeel score badge, score 70+. White text 5.02:1. Refined from #16a34a (3.30:1).

tokens.name: score-mid
tokens.usage: Deeel score badge, 50–69. White text 5.02:1. Refined from #d97706 (3.19:1).

tokens.name: score-low
tokens.usage: Deeel score badge, under 50. White text 4.76:1. Refined from #94a3b8 (2.56:1).

tokens.name: fresh
tokens.usage: Freshness badge text, seen under 7 days, on success-tint (4.79:1). Refined from #16a34a.

tokens.name: ageing
tokens.usage: Freshness badge text, seen 7–14 days, on warning-tint (4.84:1). Refined from #d97706.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Freshness badge text, seen over 14 days ('Data too old'), on sample-tint (6.92:1). Refined from #9ca3af / #94a3b8.

tokens.name: sample
tokens.usage: Sample-data badge and banner text on sample-tint (6.92:1).

tokens.name: sample-tint
tokens.usage: Sample-data badge and banner background; stale badge background.

tokens.name: sample-outline
tokens.usage: 1px dashed outline of the sample-data badge. Decorative: the words 'Sample data' carry the meaning.

tokens.name: unverified
tokens.usage: Pending/unverified tag: white text on it 5.17:1, or as text on info-tint 4.75:1.

tokens.name: shop-tesco
tokens.usage: Tesco initials badge 'T' background; text on-shop-light (7.67:1).

tokens.name: shop-sainsburys
tokens.usage: Sainsbury's initials badge 'S' background; text on-shop-dark (5.15:1). The code's white failed (3.07:1).

tokens.name: shop-waitrose
tokens.usage: Waitrose initials badge 'W' background; text on-shop-light (4.61:1).

tokens.name: shop-marks-and-spencer
tokens.usage: M&S initials badge 'M&S' background; text on-shop-light (16.7:1).

tokens.name: shop-lidl
tokens.usage: Lidl initials badge 'L' background; text on-shop-lidl (6.49:1).

tokens.name: shop-pret
tokens.usage: Pret initials badge 'P' background; text on-shop-light (8.98:1).

tokens.name: on-shop-light
tokens.usage: Initials on shop-tesco, shop-waitrose, shop-marks-and-spencer, shop-pret.

tokens.name: on-shop-dark
tokens.usage: Initials on shop-sainsburys.

tokens.name: on-shop-lidl
tokens.usage: Initials on shop-lidl, as in shop_images.py.

tokens.name: shop-fallback
tokens.usage: Badge for an unknown chain; text in text (6.16:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines only: posters, social posts, landing hero. Never in the app.

styles.name: score-numeral
styles.usage: The big Deeel score number in marketing and the score popover. Tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings: 'Your best option', 'More at {shop}', 'Other nearby shops' (st.subheader).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The headline basket price on result cards and deal comparison. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card heading: shop name, item name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chicken wrap + Sea Salt crisps + Coke Zero
styles.usage: Body copy, basket lines, nutrition lines.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Deal line, emphasised values inside body text.

styles.name: price-sm
styles.usage: Item prices in pickers, tables and comparisons. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, pills, buttons, the Deeel score badge.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Some nutrition data from Open Food Facts

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges: freshness, sample data, Best match, unverified. The smallest size allowed; the code's 10px badges move up to this.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding; gap between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge and chip horizontal padding; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile; stack gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; mobile page gutter; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between result sections; desktop column gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a section heading; marketing layout margins.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Shop initials badge, thumbnails (as in shop_images.py).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the stale card, warning and info boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Result cards and other bordered containers.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, the Deeel score badge, freshness and sample-data badges.

shadow.note: At most two levels. App cards are bordered, not shadowed.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers and the mobile filter sheet only.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Hype mode only: hard offset shadow under stickers, savings badges and marketing blocks. Never on safety surfaces.

tokens.name: border-width-hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, sample-data dashed outline, chip outlines.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Featured card border in primary; sticker outlines in text; active task card.
